title: Chapter 1424 - 574: Situ Xing vs Ning Zhuo · Yin Zhu
content:
Chapter 1424: Chapter 574: Situ Xing vs Ning Zhuo · Yin Zhu

The Beidou Seven Luminaries Sword Formation is definitely ineffective.

Situ Xing felt strange and puzzled, not knowing how to respond for a moment.

Ning Zhuo continued, "If you have no strength left, I’d rather stop and let you set up your array."

Upon hearing this, Situ Xing felt a surge of anger rush to his head, his entire body heated up.

"Ning Zhuo has gone too far!" Situ Xing gritted his teeth. He wasn’t planning to use his trump card, but under the fire of anger, he revealed it directly.

He threw out three cards at once!

A Star-maned Sword Wolf, entirely silver, with mane like meteor tails and eyes of pale gold, had a row of short sword-like bone spurs along its spine.

A Seven-star Sword Butterfly, with a wingspan of three feet, had deep blue transparent wings, trailing a stardust path as it danced, extraordinarily beautiful yet hiding deadly intentions.

A Star Shining Sword Falcon, with a wingspan of twelve feet, its feathers silver gray, the tips glowing with faint blue starlight. Its talons were like sword hooks, beak like sword tips, its eyes shooting sword gleams.

All three Demon Beasts were of Golden Core Level, specially borrowed from his family by Situ Xing to counter Ning Zhuo’s Golden Core Level Mechanical Puppet.

In fact, since his battle with Zhu Fenxiang, he has been recovering while preparing to deal with Ning Zhuo.

The three Demon Beasts surrounded Ning Zhuo, while Situ Xing took the opportunity to begin setting up a new sword array.

The beast pets needed no command from Situ Xing, coordinating seamlessly with each other. Each one could fly, continuously attacking Ning Zhuo.

Ning Zhuo, using Azure-Iron Han Armor: Golden Swallow, fought for a while, then decisively threw out a Mechanical Puppet.

This was a human-shaped puppet, more than seven feet tall, its whole body semi-transparent bamboo green, visible blue-black meridians from the outside. Its body was like stacked bamboo joints, with twisted patterns at the joints.

Its face had no features, only a deep cavity occasionally laced with starlight.

It was—The Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard.

This was the only Golden Core Level Mechanical Puppet from the Empty Valley Sound Green Mechanism Tube heritage.

Since obtaining it, Ning Zhuo practiced controlling it in the gaps of daily cultivation, accumulating very little time.

This time, Ning Zhuo actively used it in actual combat.

Five Elements Condensed Silk!

Ning Zhuo used Mana Suspended Threads for control.

The Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard tangled with the Star-maned Sword Wolf constantly, easing Ning Zhuo’s pressure significantly.

Ning Zhuo removed Azure-Iron Han Armor: Golden Swallow and switched to another set of Mechanical Battle Armor.

Seven hundred and twenty bamboo green armor plates flew from the Storage Bag, piecing together on Ning Zhuo, seamlessly fitting. The joints layered with bamboo segments, moving freely.

The surface patterns of the armor plates connected precisely, forming a Green Bamboo Battle Robe.

It was Azure Bamboo Armor of a Hundred Transformations.

The Star Shining Sword Falcon swooped in, and Ning Zhuo raised his left arm.

With a thought, armor plates on his left arm flew out, becoming one from two, two from four, aggressively expanding in number.

The extra plates pieced together into a Green Bamboo Shield.

The Star Shining Sword Falcon’s attack was blocked by the Green Bamboo Shield, and Ning Zhuo stepped back slightly.

He extended his right arm, grabbed at the air. Under his Divine Sense control, plates on the right arm multiplied, forming a Green Bamboo Square Hammer, held in Ning Zhuo’s hand.

Ning Zhuo swung the hammer, sending the approaching Seven-star Sword Butterfly crashing to the ground.

"Oh oh oh!" Shen Xi and Lin Jinglong exclaimed in unison again, their eyes sparkling, fixated on the Azure Bamboo Armor of a Hundred Transformations, envy overflowing their faces.

Ning Zhuo with combat training, found himself increasingly constrained after fighting for a short while.

"Though this Azure Bamboo Armor of a Hundred Transformations can change components and growth speed, it’s still not as swift as Azure-Iron Han Armor: Golden Swallow."

Realizing this, Ning Zhuo threw out the Green Forest Python Chariot.

Using the millennium-aged Grounded Green Python Bamboo as the main material, ninety-nine bamboo tubes linked together seamlessly, with joints embedded with Flood-Dragon Tendon, extending and retracting like a living python.

Ning Zhuo sat on the Coiled Dragon Bamboo Chair of the python body, tossed out a Mechanical Long Whip.

The whole whip was jade green, each segment shaped like bamboo joints, interlinked. Cloud patterns swirled across the surface, with hidden blue light between joints. The whip tip resembled a sharp bamboo shoot, capable of stabbing, while the tail was bamboo root shaped, capable of hooking and locking.

It was the Hundred-Segment Langgan Whip.

The Green Forest Python Chariot emitted a deep hum, bamboo tubes extending, darting out like a living python, easily dodging the Star Shining Sword Falcon’s attack.

Ning Zhuo swung out the Hundred-Segment Langgan Whip.

The whip cut through the air, tracing a jade green arc, compressed space between segments, producing a sharp explosive sound. One hundred and eight segments resonated sequentially, sound upon sound, momentarily like a thousand bamboos chirping together.

Mechanical Techniques—Firecracker Whip!

The long whip lashed onto the Star Shining Sword Falcon, immediately sending it flying.

Bang bang bang...

As the Star Shining Sword Falcon was sent flying, explosive sounds continued internally and externally, suffering a series of subsequent attacks.

The Hundred-Segment Langgan Whip was also part of the Empty Valley Sound Green Mechanism Tube. The heritage’s feature is controlling mechanisms with music skills, using mechanisms to demonstrate music skills, complementing each other.

The Mechanical Techniques Firecracker Whip can only be executed with the Hundred-Segment Langgan Whip. Initially, it’s through explosive sound accelerating the whip’s lashing and swinging speed, then increasing the strike’s attack power, eventually forcing the sound explosion into the target’s body for a secondary detonation.

Ning Zhuo, riding the Green Forest Python Chariot, suddenly accelerated, the python body tracing arcs in the air continuously. The Hundred-Segment Langgan Whip, in Ning Zhuo’s hand, swung vigorously, sometimes straightly lashing, sometimes spinning like a windmill.

Bang bang bang...

The sound of firecrackers was never-ending.

The Star Shining Sword Falcon went flying with disheveled feathers, the Seven-star Sword Butterfly staggered, the Star-maned Sword Wolf barely broke free from The Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard’s entanglement, charged, only to be lashed by the long whip, yelping repeatedly in pain, covered in dust.
